title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00094 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Continued r/d WL BOP and lower riser. L/d lower riser in moonpool.
01:15 - 01:30: Performed TBT for removal of WL adapter and installing lifting cap
01:30 - 02:15: Removed wireline adapter and installed lift cap on XT. Meanwhile electrician and hydraulic mech. Prepared to disconnect cables and hoses from XT.
02:15 - 03:00: Electrician and hydraulic mech. Continued disconnecting electrical cables and hydraulic hoses from XT. Meanwhile removed wireline BOP hoses from moonpool hatch.
03:00 - 03:30: Prepared to remove hatches on well f-1 and f-6. Meanwhile continued to remove wireline BOP hoses from moonpool.
03:30 - 04:00: Performed housekeeping and PDO check in moonpool prior to lifting hatches.
04:00 - 04:15: Performed handover meeting with new drilling crew
04:15 - 05:00: R/u and pulled split hatch on well f-1 c.
05:00 - 07:00: R/u and pulled split hatches from f-1 and pulled hatch on f-6. Removed steel beam between hatches. Meanwhile lifted WL BOP out of moonpool. Prepared foxhole running tool and installed same.
07:00 - 07:30: Performed handover meeting with new service crew. Prepared and activated permits. Meanwhile performed housekeeping and drops check in moonpool area. Pulled foxhole.
07:30 - 08:45: Pulled masterbushing and rotary ring. Installed hand rails. Lowered TDS lifting arrangement and installed same on XT with double securing. Lifted and held 2 ton tension. Removed XT clamp. Disconnected XT and lifted same into moonpool.
08:45 - 09:15: Attempted to shift load from TDS to port gantry crane. Unable to gain enough height on gantry crane to move XT into moonpool.
09:15 - 09:30: Performed new TBT to discuss situation.
09:30 - 10:30: Re-rigged lifting arrangement and landed XT on skid in moonpool.
10:30 - 12:00: Lowered 2 tuggers into moonpool and attached to XT spool. Removed nt2 connector. Disconnected and lifted XT spool through rotary and l/d same on drill floor. Meanwhile. Secured XT on skid.
12:00 - 12:15: Performed hando

sections.text: Continued r/d WL BOP and lower riser. L/d lower riser in moonpool.
Performed TBT for removal of WL adapter and installing lifting cap
Removed wireline adapter and installed lift cap on XT. Meanwhile electrician and hydraulic mech. Prepared to disconnect cables and hoses from XT.
Electrician and hydraulic mech. Continued disconnecting electrical cables and hydraulic hoses from XT. Meanwhile removed wireline BOP hoses from moonpool hatch.
Prepared to remove hatches on well f-1 and f-6. Meanwhile continued to remove wireline BOP hoses from moonpool.
Performed housekeeping and PDO check in moonpool prior to lifting hatches.
Performed handover meeting with new drilling crew
R/u and pulled split hatch on well f-1 c.
R/u and pulled split hatches from f-1 and pulled hatch on f-6. Removed steel beam between hatches. Meanwhile lifted WL BOP out of moonpool. Prepared foxhole running tool and installed same.
Performed handover meeting with new service crew. Prepared and activated permits. Meanwhile performed housekeeping and drops check in moonpool area. Pulled foxhole.

Pulled masterbushing and rotary ring. Installed hand rails. Lowered TDS lifting arrangement and installed same on XT with double securing. Lifted and held 2 ton tension. Removed XT clamp. Disconnected XT and lifted same into moonpool.
Attempted to shift load from TDS to port gantry crane. Unable to gain enough height on gantry crane to move XT into moonpool.
Performed new TBT to discuss situation.
Re-rigged lifting arrangement and landed XT on skid in moonpool.
Lowered 2 tuggers into moonpool and attached to XT spool. Removed nt2 connector. Disconnected and lifted XT spool through rotary and l/d same on drill floor. Meanwhile. Secured XT on skid.
Performed handover meeting with new drilling crew.
Installed outer ring and masterbushing.
Prepared multibowl for installing riser joint. Meanwhile removed foxhole running tool and l/o same.
Disassebled control lines from XT and installed communication collar in multibowl. Meanwhile cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Prepared riser joint for transfer to TDS.
Performed TBT for p/u and installing riser joint
P/u riser joint from HTS. Removed masterbushings and outer ring in rotary. Ran riser joint through rotary and landed on multibowl.
M/u nt2 connection on multibowl. Meanwhile r/d double lifting arrangement.
Performed TBT for installing beam and hatches on f-1 and f-6.
Installed beam and hatches on f-1 and f-6. Meanwhile removed WL grease skid from drill floor. Prepared slick joint and diverter for installation.
Continued installing hatches on f-1 and f-6. Meanwhile continued preparing slick joint and diverter.
Installed scaffolding in moonpool. Meanwhile prepared equipment for testing BOP
